scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev:full --workspace @dentalai/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @dentalai/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @dentalai/api
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @dentalai/contracts && npm run build --workspace @dentalai/domain && npm run build --workspace @dentalai/database && npm run build --workspace @dentalai/ui
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @dentalai/web && npm run build --workspace @dentalai/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:db: npm run test:integration --workspace @dentalai/database && npm run test:integration --workspace @dentalai/api
scripts.test:watch: npm run build:packages && npm run test:watch --workspace @dentalai/web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build && npm run audit
scripts.infra:up:ai: docker compose --env-file infra/.env -f infra/compose.yml --profile ai up -d
